    //==
    // # Lifting any field into function-valued form
    //
    // One interface-typed function per family lifts EVERY implementor of that field
    // interface — constant fields, metaball systems, sampled SDFs, noise, and the
    // function-valued fields themselves — into the combinator algebra below.
    //
    // Each is named after its return type, so each is an IMPLICIT conversion: the
    // lifted field evaluates to the same value at every point as the field it came
    // from, nothing is sampled or approximated, and no parameter is invented
    // (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions).

    // The field as a function-valued planar scalar field, holding a lambda that
    // evaluates this field.
    ScalarFunctionField2D(self: IScalarField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => ScalarFunctionField2D(p => self.Eval(p));
